entities.summary: Joseph Cardona is an American U.S. Naval Reserve officer and professional football long snapper for the Los Angeles Rams of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Navy Midshipmen and was selected by the New England Patriots in the fifth round of the 2015 NFL draft.
